question: N. Biren Singh became the chief minister of ________ state of India in March 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 4**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **N Biren Singh** as the **Chief Minister of Manipur** has been facing **allegations of pushing an anti-tribal agenda** since he came to power in **2017** and was re-elected by the Meitei majority in **2022.**
 
• The ruling BJP party contested all 60 seats in the Manipur Assembly election in** 2022 and won 32 seats**.
 
• **Nongthombam (N) Biren Singh **started his career as a **footballer**, then turned to **journalism, before joining politics**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Manipur** is situated in the** easternmost part of India **and shares borders with **Nagaland to the north, Mizoram to the south, Assam to the west, and Myanmar (Burma) to the east.**
 
• The state is known for its scenic beauty with** hills, valleys, rivers, and lakes**.
 
• It is often referred to as the **"Jewel of India."**
